validity.researcher_notes: The Mobile Compressor Expansion is compression-only, not new mainline pipe. Federal Register notice E7-12180 (June 25, 2007): Gulf South proposed to 'construct, own, operate, and maintain two new compressor stations, the Whistler Junction Compressor Station (Whistler Junction) and the Airport Junction Compressor Station (Airport Junction) in Mobile County, Alabama ... designed to deliver, on a firm basis, 250,000 Dth per day to Gulfstream Natural Gas System, L.L.C. (Gulfstream), an interstate pipeline, at an existing interconnect near Coden, Alabama in Mobile County ... All construction will be contained within Gulf South's property' (https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2007-06-25/pdf/E7-12180.pdf, verified 200/contains 'Mobile County'). The 250,000 Dth/d figure matches the sheet's Capacity=250.00 MMcf/d exactly, and StartState/Province=Alabama matches Mobile County. No mainline loop, lateral, or diameter is mentioned anywhere in the notice — construction is confined to two new compressor stations on existing Gulf South property, consistent with the sheet's LengthKnownKm=0.00. Per the compression-only-expansion rule (gotcha 3), the blank Diameter is correct. I did not find a second independent source naming this specific project (searched Natural Gas Intel, Oil & Gas Journal, FERC eLibrary by keyword); tier held at medium on the one verified Federal Register filing.
